title: FLOSS/fund
description: Zerodha's fund for Free and Open Source projects, $1 million a year. Individuals, projects, communities and organisations apply by publishing a funding.json manifest and submitting its URL to the public directory. Focus is on existing, widely used and impactful projects; very new projects or projects with minimal usage are not considered for now.
reward: $10,000 to $100,000 per project in one year, requested as $10,000 minimum and multiples of $25,000 thereafter

eligibility.note: existing, widely used and impactful open source projects; very new or little-used projects are not considered

setup: publish a funding manifest on your site or repo
rules: Applications stay open all year; the committee evaluates applications at the end of every quarter and sends decisions by email. A fresh $1 million was planned for 2026.
Individuals, projects, groups, communities or organisations can apply, for one project or for an entity representing many.
Focus is on existing, widely used and impactful projects and their sustainability. Very new projects or projects with minimal usage are not considered for the time being.
Request up to $100,000 in one year, as a minimum of $10,000 and multiples of $25,000 thereafter.
Apply by publishing a funding.json manifest (see fundingjson.org) and submitting its URL to the directory. The application is publicly visible on the directory.
Projects are evaluated on value, impact, criticality and innovation by Zerodha's internal investment committee. Decisions come by email.
A bank account and tax papers are needed to receive the funds. Paperwork after acceptance can take up to 4 weeks.
Funded projects are asked to publicly acknowledge the fund with a link to its website.

submission_requirements.label: funding.json manifest URL
submission_requirements.description: The manifest needs entity (type, role, name, email, description, webpage), funding channels and plans (amount, currency, frequency); projects list name, description, webpage, repository, licenses and tags. URLs on another host are unverified unless that host serves /.well-known/funding-manifest-urls.
